attractions.name: Central Park
attractions.description: Iconic urban park. Suggested walk: Strawberry Fields (John Lennon memorial), Bow Bridge and Bethesda Terrace and Fountain.
tips: Check weather before visiting in cold or rainy conditions

attractions.name: Times Square
attractions.description: Iconic landmark with giant digital billboards, crowds and street performers. The red steps at Father Duffy Square give a panoramic view.
tips: Visit in the evening for the illuminated billboards

attractions.name: Bronx Zoo
attractions.description: Zoo with lions, gorillas, flamingos and the Bug Carousel
tips: Take a cab back for a quicker return if children are tired

attractions.name: 9/11 Memorial
attractions.description: Memorial with two reflecting pools on the footprints of the former Twin Towers, with victims' names inscribed around the edges.
tips: Approach respectfully as a place of remembrance

attractions.name: Brooklyn Bridge
attractions.description: Walk across the bridge with sunset views and city lights
tips: Best at sunset

attractions.name: Dumbo Pebble Beach
attractions.description: Pebble beach in Dumbo, Brooklyn

attractions.name: St Patrick's Cathedral
attractions.description: Neo-Gothic cathedral on Fifth Avenue with stained-glass windows and an ornate interior.

attractions.name: LEGO Store
attractions.description: Play zones, giant models and build-your-own kits

attractions.name: Rockefeller Plaza
attractions.description: Prometheus statue, Channel Gardens and a seasonal ice rink

attractions.name: Radio City Music Hall
attractions.description: Iconic music hall that is lit up in the evening

attractions.name: Color Factory NYC

tips: Last entry at 6 pm
Buy tickets in advance

attractions.name: Harry Potter Store
attractions.description: Store at 935 Broadway with wand walls, house robes and Butterbeer

attractions.name: Statue of Liberty Sunset Cruise (Circle Line)
attractions.description: Evening cruise with close views of the Statue of Liberty and the NYC skyline at golden hour, departing from Circle Line Cruise Terminal
tips: Comfortable and great for children, with restrooms, snacks and open-air decks

attractions.name: Broadway Theatre District
attractions.description: Area of famous theatres with illuminated marquees and posters, around Broadway and West 44th–48th Streets.

attractions.name: Washington Square Park
attractions.description: Greenwich Village park with the Washington Square Arch, a central fountain and street musicians, near New York University.

attractions.name: Greenwich Village & Bleecker Street
attractions.description: Neighbourhood of leafy streets, historic brownstones, cafés and independent boutiques. Suggested route: MacDougal Street, Bleecker Street, then the West Village.

attractions.name: SoHo
attractions.description: Neighbourhood known for cast-iron architecture, cobblestone streets, galleries and fashion boutiques. Look at Greene Street, Prince Street and Broadway.
tips: Good for an evening stroll even without shopping

attractions.name: Hudson Yards & The Vessel
attractions.description: Modern neighbourhood with contemporary architecture, upscale shopping and public gardens, home to the honeycomb-like Vessel structure.
attractions.hours: Shops at Hudson Yards generally open until 9 PM Monday to Saturday
attractions.entry_fee: Free to explore the public areas

attractions.name: The High Line
attractions.description: Elevated public park on a former freight railway line, with gardens, public art and views of Manhattan's streets.
tips: Start near the Hudson Yards end

attractions.name: Bryant Park
attractions.description: Green space surrounded by Midtown skyscrapers, beside the New York Public Library's Stephen A. Schwarzman Building with its stone lions.

attractions.name: Bryant Park Winter Village
attractions.description: Outdoor holiday market with stalls selling gifts, crafts, festive treats and warm drinks, open in the holiday season.
attractions.entry_fee: Free; shopping and food at additional cost

attractions.name: Rockefeller Center
attractions.description: Art Deco complex with a public plaza and the Prometheus statue. The complex is open around the clock, but individual shops and attractions keep their own hours.

attractions.name: Fifth Avenue
attractions.description: Famous shopping street with flagship stores, luxury boutiques and elegant architecture. The stretch around Rockefeller Center and St Patrick's Cathedral is particularly good, and early holiday window displays appear in November.
attractions.recommended_duration: About 10 minutes for the Rockefeller Center–St Patrick's stretch

attractions.name: The Plaza Hotel & Central Park South
attractions.description: Iconic hotel at the southeastern corner of Central Park, surrounded by grand hotels, luxury storefronts and park views.

attractions.name: Grand Central Terminal
attractions.description: Beaux-Arts terminal with a main concourse, a celestial ceiling, a four-faced clock and the Whispering Gallery near the Oyster Bar.
tips: Look up at the ceiling painted with constellations
Stand at opposite corners of the Whispering Gallery and speak softly towards the wall

attractions.name: Diamond District
attractions.description: Stretch of West 47th Street between Fifth and Sixth Avenues with many jewellery stores and diamond merchants.
tips: Compare prices, authenticity documentation and return policies before buying higher-value items

attractions.name: Statue of Liberty & Ellis Island
attractions.description: Ferry from The Battery to Liberty Island and Ellis Island, with the Statue of Liberty Museum and the National Museum of Immigration.
tips: Arrive early to clear security screening at The Battery before boarding
Crown and pedestal access is not covered by standard ferry tickets with audioguide
Check the day's return ferry schedule before exploring the islands

attractions.name: The Battery
attractions.description: Waterfront park at the southern tip of Manhattan with harbour views, gardens, monuments and public art.

attractions.name: 9/11 Memorial Museum
attractions.description: Museum documenting the attacks and their impact through photographs, personal accounts, artefacts and multimedia exhibits.
tips: Advance booking recommended
Substantial and emotionally intense visit

attractions.name: Oculus & Brookfield Place
attractions.description: The Oculus is a white ribbed transport hub and shopping destination near the World Trade Center. Brookfield Place is a waterfront shopping and dining complex with Hudson River views.

attractions.name: Wall Street & Financial District
attractions.description: Historic district with Wall Street, the New York Stock Exchange, Federal Hall (linked to George Washington's inauguration) and Trinity Church.

attractions.name: Charging Bull & Stone Street
attractions.description: The bronze Charging Bull sculpture at Bowling Green, and the historic cobblestone Stone Street lined with restaurants and bars.

attractions.name: American Museum of Natural History
attractions.description: Upper West Side museum covering dinosaurs, ocean life, mammals, human origins and space. Highlights include the Fossil Halls, Milstein Hall of Ocean Life with its blue whale model, mammal dioramas, the Rose Center for Earth and Space and the Richard Gilder Center.
tips: Wheelchair accessible; indicate the requirement when booking

attractions.name: Top of the Rock Observation Deck
attractions.description: Rockefeller Center observation deck with views of the Empire State Building, Central Park and the Manhattan skyline.
tips: Advance booking recommended

attractions.name: Statue of Liberty
attractions.description: Ferry from Battery Park (South Ferry) to the Statue of Liberty, with a climb up the pedestal
tips: Collect pre-paid tickets at the ticket box office in Battery Park well before the ferry check-in time

attractions.name: Museum of Ice Cream

attractions.hours: Last entry 6:30pm; entry valid for 1 hour

safety_tips.tip: Use licensed yellow taxis, Uber or Lyft and confirm the destination before departure
Keep valuables, passports and wallets secure in crowded areas such as Times Square, Grand Central Terminal and busy shopping streets
Stay alert, use well-lit streets and avoid isolated areas late at night
Be cautious of unsolicited offers, street scams and unexpected payment requests
Keep bags close in crowded places and on public transport
Check weather conditions before visiting Central Park or taking the Staten Island Ferry in cold or rainy weather
Keep a separate digital copy of passport and important travel documents
Tipping people, especially at restaurants, is a norm. Restaurant waiters expect 18%-25% of total bill as tips. Also customary to add 10%-15% tips for taxi rides

Most places in the US are pretty dry and it is easy to get sunburnt, so carry and apply sunscreen (SPF 30) when out in the Sun
Boston and NYC could get cold at night. Boston max temp: 15°C, min: 8°C. NYC pretty similar to Boston. Pack winter weather clothes accordingly

season_notes.tip: In early to mid May, temperatures range from about 11°C to 24°C

November weather can be chilly, with cold winds, rain and occasional early wintry conditions
Layering makes it easier to move between outdoor sightseeing and heated indoor attractions
